interpretation.Build: Actual 5,455,347,712-byte development ISO; original base + authenticated native app delta + dpkg-owned OREZ layer + live owner policy. Not an approved installation release.
interpretation.Evidence: Report PNGs reproduce build/test output. VM PNGs capture actual diskless/offline guest displays. Nonblank login frames are not desktop or install certification.
interpretation.Failures: First two enrollment attempts exposed the initial dummy password; failed captures and acceptance checks are retained. Those disposable guests and credentials were destroyed before publication. No real owner password was used.
interpretation.Third boot: Plymouth-exit wait concealed both observed enrollment inputs; console/graphical owner authentication succeeded and passwordless sudo was refused. Software rendering/startup remained limited; QMP capture collision stopped the run. See each vm_diagnostic for exact final scope.
interpretation.Fourth boot: Same ISO, software-backed VirGL: enrollment hidden and tty2 owner authentication reached a shell. No usable desktop qualified. SDL capture timeout ended the harness; 74 complete frames retained. One truncated output is recorded but excluded. All disposable credentials and guests destroyed.
interpretation.Scope: No physical NVIDIA/Secure Boot/radios/phone/USB qualification, installed disk footprint, Android apps or active OREZ AI. Any synthetic media is a read-only test fixture.
interpretation.Status: Read the current branch docs/AI_HANDOFF.md and each run diagnostic. A capture command exit of zero is not a desktop acceptance pass. This archive is screenshots, not an OS download.
